source_reviews.independent_solution: Under the same local gravitational conditions, gravitational-force magnitude is directly proportional to mass: F=k*m with the same positive k, hence F1/F2=m1/m2 for positive masses. The same mass factor gives the same force factor, and equal masses give equal forces under those conditions. Shape or equal volume does not replace the specified mass relation. The independent source solution and the subsequent blind calculations were saved before reading author keys.
